heading: The tick's cost in this edition
text:
### The tick's cost in this edition [LDTL.6.4]

[LDTL.6.3]'s bounds do not bind this edition. In either mode the TTL tick's
cost is at most linear in N_ttl, the number of live facts that carry a
deadline: a runtime may examine each of them on every tick, and expires those
whose deadline is at or before the tick's instant, in [LDTL.6.1]'s or
[LDTL.6.2]'s order. The tick may allocate to hold the facts it expires.
